summary: Bilibili Inc. filed a Form 6-K on November 6, 2026, attaching its monthly return to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange for October 2026, covering movements in authorized share capital and issued shares. The Class Z ordinary shares (HKEX: 09626) rose by 3,052 shares, leaving 340,437,788 issued; Class Y WVR shares remained at 79,700,010. No price, stake, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are stated. This is a routine HKEX equity-issuer monthly return (US equivalent: routine share-count update), not a special situation; no deal-arb angle.
